primary_metric_space: pseudobulk log2FC proxy; not a VCC score
non_inferiority_note: Not set, exactly as in m001. Declaring non-inferiority requires a margin fixed from an independent measure of baseline repeatability, before the comparison.
winner_reason: No winner. Architecture was not selected on the external test. Every fold trains on more than one context, so a context descriptor can vary in training and a with/without comparison is at least identifiable in principle; two contexts still confound biology with the experiment each came from. If seed intervals overlap, the result is inconclusive.

preprocess.vram_note: no CUDA device in this environment; VRAM not measured

matrix.X: non-negative integer (or integer-valued) counts, CSR or dense float that is integral
matrix.gene_axis: source symbols aligned to the official 18,533 with an observed mask; unmeasured genes stay masked

obs.target_gene: perturbed gene symbol or the NTC label
obs.context: biological context, one value for the bundle
obs.guide_id: if present, kept; same-target guides stay together
obs.donor: if present, never pooled across donors
obs.batch: if present, NTCs must be matchable per batch
obs.n_cells_min_per_target: enough to run DE; the competition asks 400 predicted cells, the bundle can be smaller if declared

scoring.anchors: without published b and r, report raw aggregates and a local normalisation explicitly distinct from the leaderboard

candidates_not_acquired.why_smallest: Roadmap R-1: 0.851 GB compressed, 145,473 × 9,624, 4,976 NTC. Smallest complete perturbed object with explicit NTCs.
candidates_not_acquired.role_if_acquired: methodological evaluation bundle: generator × predictor on real perturbed cells. NOT a benchmark of the 300-target panel.
candidates_not_acquired.read_mode: chunked; do not materialise the dense matrix (~5.6 GB)
candidates_not_acquired.license_note: public GEO; confirm before any submission use

candidates_not_acquired.why: Roadmap R-1 alternative: 1.237 GB compressed, 247,914 × 8,749, 11,485 NTC. Same experiment as the local RPE1 pseudobulk.
candidates_not_acquired.role_if_acquired: pairs with local RPE1 pseudobulk: same biological context, real single-cell counts for the six VCC metrics.

acquisition.byte_budget: the smaller of the two candidates is ~0.85 GB compressed; keep ≥10 GiB free (D-005)
acquisition.after_download: chunked subset of perturbed cells + paired NTCs, written as an evaluation bundle with a new --out, never overwriting existing reports

what_this_does_not_show: A better generator is not evidence that the predictor is adequate.
A better generator is not evidence that modularity is useless.
Zero panel overlap: this bundle would not score the 300 VCC targets.

estimated_bundle_pilot.note: 30 × 80 + 400 NTC at 8,749 genes, float32 dense ≈ 98 MB. CSR of integer counts would be smaller. This is a planning figure, not a measurement.
